parent_objective: audit the instrumented public rerun before controller-family interpretation
blocked_by: need outcome-semantics audit before interpreting off-track dominated instrumented rerun results
supersedes: raw success interpretation without outcome semantics
direct ranking from M1698 execution artifacts

public_gates: M1699 must audit M1698 required artifacts, outcome fields, finite metrics, and guardrails
M1699 must interpret off-track/collision/pass buckets before any controller-family comparison
M1699 must decide whether the next route is task-quality repair, corridor/boundary tuning, or branch synthesis
M1699 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, private-holdout evidence, or level3 self-ID
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune profiles from M1698 diagnostics

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits outcome-semantics results from the instrumented public rerun
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit and next-route decision only; no training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if outcome fields are missing
stop if audit ignores off-track dominance
stop if audit directly ranks controllers before task-quality decision
stop if next route is not explicit
fallback_plan: route to task-quality/corridor design if off-track dominance invalidates ranking
route to branch synthesis if the current workload has reached synthesis cadence
route to controlled comparison audit if outcome buckets are interpretable enough

admission_evidence: M1698 completes the instrumented 864-cell public rerun with outcome aggregates
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1699 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up design synthesis or task-quality manifest
next_stage_criteria: M1698 artifact integrity and guardrails are audited
outcome bucket interpretation caveats are stated

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1699 audits public rollout diagnostics but does not by itself prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit L1, L2-current-tiled, L3-online, and L3-reset comparison rows as diagnostic only
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If reset/current-tiled controls match or beat history profiles, record this as task-quality or history-necessity evidence gap instead of weakening the claim standard.
allowed_claims: no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1698 can be audited into an explicit next route by separating off-track dominance from obstacle-collision avoidance outcomes.
success_criteria: outcome and termination-reason aggregates are audited
training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit interprets raw diagnostics as controller-family ranking or paper-level evidence
audit routes directly to training or profile tuning without design
training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit M1698 instrumented rerun artifacts and write next-route decision

decision_rule: M1699 passes if it audits M1698 outcome semantics and routes to an explicit next milestone without overclaiming.
